summary.en: Cross-gradient LC-HRMS feature correspondence and cross-fragmentation spectral-library matching.
summary.zh: 跨梯度 LC-HRMS 特征对应与跨碎裂方式谱库匹配。

en: Two studies connect measurements acquired under different conditions: retention-time transfer links chromatographic feature tables, while paired EAD/CID spectra help evaluate cross-fragmentation library searches. Both emphasize coverage, ambiguity and the limits of annotation.

Coverage spans accessible primary metadata and scientific excerpts across proteomics, small molecules, lipids, ion mobility and imaging. Some publisher pages and feeds were unavailable; this is not an exhaustive survey. Reading scope is stated for each paper; no results were reproduced.
zh: 两项研究连接不同采集条件下的质谱测量：保留时间迁移用于对应色谱特征表，配对 EAD/CID 谱则支持评估跨碎裂方式谱库搜索。两者均需关注覆盖率、歧义和注释边界。
本次覆盖蛋白组、小分子、脂质、离子淌度和成像等方向的可访问原始元数据与科学内容片段；部分出版商页面及 feed 不可访问，不能视为穷尽检索。每篇均注明实际阅读范围，未进行实验复现。

papers.title: Retention-Time Bridging across Gradients for LC-HRMS Feature Correspondence
papers.journal: Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry

read_scope.en: Publisher-indexed abstract and article metadata; full text and supplements not read; no reproduction.
read_scope.zh: 原始出版商索引可读摘要及文章元数据；未读全文或补充材料，未复现。

commentary.en: RTBridge selects mass-unique, cross-method mass-consistent and abundance-concordant anchors to link short- and long-gradient LC-HRMS feature tables without molecular structures, comparing six retention-time transfer models. PCHIP recovered 5,595 primary feature pairs across four matrix/mode datasets with a mean median RT error of 0.0232 minutes; residual-based hard filtering slightly improved error but reduced coverage, highlighting an accuracy–recovery tradeoff. This establishes feature correspondence, not metabolite identification; transfer across platforms, columns and laboratories remains unvalidated.
commentary.zh: RTBridge 利用同一样本的质荷比唯一性、跨方法质量一致性与丰度一致性选择锚点，在不依赖分子结构的情况下连接短、长梯度 LC-HRMS 特征表，并比较六种保留时间迁移模型。PCHIP 在四组基质/模式数据中得到 5,595 对主要特征，平均中位保留时间误差为 0.0232 分钟；残差硬筛选仅略降误差，却损失匹配覆盖，提示研发中应共同评估精度与保留率。该方法建立的是特征对应而非代谢物鉴定，跨平台、色谱柱及实验室迁移仍需直接验证。

papers.title: From Single Injection to Dual Insights: Integrating EAD and CID Acquisition for Spectral Library Generation and EAD–CID Spectral Matching

read_scope.en: Publisher-indexed article metadata and results/conclusion excerpts, with author-institution and PubMed author verification; full article and supplements not read in entirety; no reproduction.
read_scope.zh: 原始出版商索引可读文章元数据及结果/结论段落，辅以作者机构记录与 PubMed 核对作者；未完整通读全文或补充材料，未复现。

commentary.en: A single-injection, multi-energy EAD/CID workflow generated a resource of 459 CID and 414 EAD spectra from 45 steroid standards, supporting spectral-library expansion and fragmentation-model development. EAD spectra could also match existing CID/HCD libraries, but isomer mismatches remained prominent: public-data hits are putative annotations, not substitutes for orthogonal confirmation such as reference-standard retention times. The cross-fragmentation matching evidence is useful, although generalization beyond steroids remains untested.
commentary.zh: 该流程在单次进样中获取多能量 EAD/CID 谱，并由 45 种甾体标准品构建含 459 张 CID 和 414 张 EAD 谱的资源，为谱库扩充及碎裂模型开发提供数据。研究发现 EAD 谱也可匹配现有 CID/HCD 谱库，但异构体误匹配仍突出，公共数据中的命中只能作为暂定注释，不能替代标准品保留时间等正交确认。其跨碎裂方式检索价值值得关注，但跨化学类别的可迁移性尚待验证。
